# Folderss DB Helper

> Oracle DB helper plugin for the Folderss file manager. Its "테이블 정의서 만들기" feature renders Excel (.xlsx) templates with a Velocity-subset engine to produce table definition documents from the Oracle data dictionary.

## Table definition templates (테이블 정의서 양식)

- [Template authoring guide (Markdown, Korean)](https://zaruous.github.io/Folderss-oracle-db-helper/table-spec-templates/guide.md): rendering rules, syntax, every variable, data rules, how to build with openpyxl, validation checklist. Read this first.
- [Variables (JSON)](https://zaruous.github.io/Folderss-oracle-db-helper/table-spec-templates/variables.json): machine-readable variable schema (roots, objects, list item types).
- [make_template.py](https://zaruous.github.io/Folderss-oracle-db-helper/table-spec-templates/examples/make_template.py): example that builds a template from scratch with openpyxl.
- [check_template.py](https://zaruous.github.io/Folderss-oracle-db-helper/table-spec-templates/examples/check_template.py): validator — run `python check_template.py template.xlsx` before handing a template to the user.

## Where templates go

- User template folder (Windows): `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Folderss\plugin-data\zaruous.folderss-db-helper	emplates\` — every `.xlsx` there appears in DB Helper's template list as "내 양식 — <file name>".
